claims.disproof_condition: 條件：NVIDIA 之後的新聞稿、法說或 10-Q/10-K 寫出 BlueField-4 儲存平台延後到 2027 以後、取消，或 KV cache 改回留在 HBM／CPU 記憶體不再卸載到 NVMe。核查頻率：每季（NVIDIA 財報與 GTC）。觸發後 48 小時：降這個節點與 NVIDIA→本層的 confidence，重讀本層讀圖的需求側。
claims.statement: NVIDIA (CES 2026-01-05): BlueField-4 powers the NVIDIA Inference Context Memory Storage Platform, a storage tier that holds Rubin cluster-level KV cache off the GPU because a KV cache cannot be stored on GPUs long term; AIC, Cloudian, DDN, Dell, HPE, Hitachi Vantara, IBM, Nutanix, Pure Storage, Supermicro, VAST Data and WEKA are among the first building platforms, available in 2H 2026. Vendor announcement; no volumes or customer orders are stated.

aliases: NVIDIA Inference Context Memory Storage Platform
nodes.name: AI inference context memory storage (KV cache tier on NVMe SSD)

source_doc.permission_basis: NVIDIA 官方新聞室公開新聞稿；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。
source_doc.title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 Powers New Class of AI-Native Storage Infrastructure for the Next Frontier of AI（NVIDIA 新聞稿，CES 2026-01-05）：BlueField-4 驅動 Inference Context Memory Storage Platform，十二家儲存廠率先建平台，2026 下半年供貨

sources.quote: NVIDIA today announced that the NVIDIA BlueField®-4 data processor, part of the full-stack NVIDIA BlueField platform, powers NVIDIA Inference Context Memory Storage Platform, a new class of AI-native storage infrastructure for the next frontier of AI.

sources.locator: 新聞稿第三段（為什麼要這一層）
sources.quote: A KV cache cannot be stored on GPUs long term, as this would create a bottleneck for real-time inference in multi-agent systems. AI-native applications require a new kind of scalable infrastructure to store and share this data.
NVIDIA Rubin cluster-level KV cache capacity, delivering the scale and efficiency required for long-context, multi-turn agentic inference.

sources.locator: 新聞稿末段（合作廠與時程）
sources.quote: Storage innovators including AIC, Cloudian, DDN, Dell Technologies, HPE, Hitachi Vantara, IBM, Nutanix, Pure Storage, Supermicro, VAST Data and WEKA are among the first building next-generation AI storage platforms with BlueField-4, which will be available in the second half of 2026.
